summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (JTM 5.2/34)

data.turoyo: i pire ḥəlla kəle kaṯi, ġaḏ̣ab diḏe, u ġaḏ̣ab diḏe knoḥət larke u zlam, lə mgarela, lə məllale mayko koṯət layko gəzzux, lu mawbəlono du maktub. <...>
data.translation: Die Alte sah ihn kommen, seinen Zorn, seine Wut sah man von Weitem, deshalb sagte sie nichts. Sie fragte den Überbringer des Briefs nicht: Woher kommst du, wohin gehst du? <...>

rationale: First II Preterit example: negated addressing of a courier by the old woman; new form justifies this speech context.

summary: mgarela is interpreted as II Preterit with feminine agent -la, supported by the old-woman topic and adjacent lə məllale. The inherited Infectum mgarat-le instead has an addressee suffix.
The passage supports the existing speaking/addressing meaning. It does not establish asking as a new lexical sense merely because the following unspoken utterance is a question.
This is one attestation of the Preterit, not evidence for a further stem, fixed idiom or etymological conclusion. The inherited unknown etymology is preserved.
Confirm the segmentation and feminine agent of mgarela against a fuller paradigm; the neighboring clause supports the reading, but there is only one supplied Preterit token.
